about_the_game:
Hoard Defender VR is a virtual reality game where you play as a dragon. Everything was relatively normal for you, burning villages and collecting treasure, until the local king had the idea to try and take your hoard! Now he's sending waves of his army, composed of everything from peasants to giants, to try and steal your hard earned gold! Luckily, they brought some of their own gold so you may just make it out of this with more gold than you started with. You just hope enough isn't taken to reveal the greatest treasure hiding underneath the gold, your dragon rubies...

Buy upgrades to get stronger!

Buy all kinds of upgrades to defend your hoard from the oncoming enemies using both Gold and Vigor! Get upgrades such as:

  • Devour, to eat enemies and use their Vigor to fuel more upgrades!

  • Smash, to crush many enemies at once with a powerful shockwave!

  • Flame Breath, to burn the entire track to a crisp!

  • Walls, to buy time before enemies start stealing gold from your hoard!

  • Cages, to capture enemies so you can deal with them when you find the time!

  • And more!

Slay your enemies in a variety of ways!

Defeat enemies by crushing them, dropping them into lava, making them go splat, and more! If you're good at managing the horde of enemies, you may just find the time to shake some gold out of them before you send them off!

Defend your hoard against waves of varied foes!

From knights, to giants, to even wizards, all kinds of enemies invade from the king's army! Block the wizard's money-thieving magic bolts, smash the giants, and slay the knights to keep them from taking your hoard!

short_description: Hoard Defender VR is a casual arcade VR game about defeating enemies as they try to take your hoard! Buy upgrades and toss enemies to keep them from draining all your gold and stealing your most prized possessions, the dragon rubies you keep lying underneath your mound of gold.
